title: In 1518, up to 400 People Danced Until They Dropped

scenes.text: In 1518, up to 400 people couldn't stop dancing.
It started in July in Strasbourg, when one woman began dancing in the street.
She kept going for nearly a week before others joined.
By August, dozens had become hundreds.
Doctors blamed hot blood and told them to dance it off. The city even hired musicians.
Stress, mouldy rye or a cult? Nobody is sure to this day.

description:
In July 1518 a woman began dancing in Strasbourg, and by August as many as 400 people were caught up in it.
Historians still argue about the cause: stress, ergot mould or something else.
What do you think happened?
